# Compute catchability from model fit and observations

Estimates the catchability coefficient (\\Q\\) for one or more survey
indices given an `FLStock` operating model and the fitted index values
from a stock assessment. The calculation accounts for survey timing,
correcting stock numbers for total mortality (\\Z\\) at the time of the
survey.

## Usage

``` r
# S4 method for class 'FLIndices,FLStock,FLQuants'
computeQ(indices, stock, fit)

# S4 method for class 'FLI,FLStock,FLQuant'
computeQ(indices, stock, fit)
```

## Arguments

- indices:

  An `FLIndices` or `FLI` (the virtual base class shared by `FLIndex`
  and `FLIndexBiomass`) object containing the survey index definitions
  (timing, selectivity pattern, etc.).

- stock:

  An `FLStock` operating model providing stock numbers and
  weight-at-age.

- fit:

  An `FLQuants` or `FLQuant` of fitted index values from the stock
  assessment model.

- ...:

  Additional arguments (unused).

## Value

An `FLQuants` or `FLQuant` of estimated catchability coefficients, one
per index (or age for biomass indices).

## Generic function

computeQ(indices, stock, fit, ...)

## See also

[survey](survey.md), [FLIndex](FLIndex.md), [FLStock](FLStock.md)

## Author

The FLR Team

## Examples

``` r
# Load datasets
data(ple4)
data(ple4.indices)
# Compute for each index and pseudo-noisy fit
pseudofit <- lapply(ple4.indices, function(x) index(x) * 0.8)
computeQ(ple4.indices, ple4, pseudofit)
```
